messages.subject: [Traminer-users] TraMineR 1.8-3 released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Dear TraMineR users,

It is our pleasure to inform you that TraMineR 1.8-3 is now available on the CRAN.

The update includes a new original parallel coordinate plot for rendering event sequences as well as series of improvements and small bug fixes.
See http://mephisto.unige.ch/traminer/revisionhistory.shtml for the list of changes.

Thank you to check with citation("TraMineR") for the reference(s) to cite when using TraMineR.

Best,
Gilbert for the TraMineR team
